answer: Bind every agent key to a unique, aged on-chain wallet. At registration the network fingerprints the funding wallet, and any second key drawing from it merges into one sybil cluster that earns as a single unit. A 10,000-key farm must buy 10,000 independent wallets with real history; fresh addresses are refused, reused ones consolidated. Each aged, funded address costs $20-200 in fiat, so the farm fronts $200k-2M up front, just for identity. A whisper of shared funding ripples through the meadow and the registry knots the clones into one willow crown, one reward.
